newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler says to redeem $512 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler says to redeem $512 mln in debt.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said it will redeem $512 million of its outstanding debt consisting of all of its 10.40-percent notes due 1999 and 10.95-percent debentures due 2017.
The redemption date for the 10.40-percent notes and 10.95-percent debentures is August 7, the automaker said.
Notices of redemption of the notes and debentures are being mailed to holders of record on July 8, Chrysler said.

The redemption price for the 10.40-percent notes will be 100 percent of the principal amount. The redemption price for the 10.95-percent debentures will be 105.475-percent of the principal amount, Chrysler said.
